errors.text: The hypothesis replaces the target FCC FeNiCrCoCu/Cu nanocoating system with a generic BCC refractory HEA and therefore invokes an inapplicable screw-dislocation mechanism.
It substitutes atmospheric reciprocating wear and tribo-oxidation for the target vacuum-like molecular-dynamics indentation/friction simulation, where oxygen and oxide-film formation are absent.
The proposed 700–800 °C degradation boundary corresponds to roughly 973–1073 K, rather than the target onset near 900 K.
The cited tribo-oxidation evidence reports protective oxide coverage and reduced wear at 800–900 °C, directly undermining the proposed oxide-spallation-driven degradation above 700 °C.
